executive_summary.overall_assessment: Call-tree inspection fixture exercising the CALL- prefix and call_tree category end-to-end.

findings.title: Unchecked recursion into untrusted path
findings.description: Following the call chain `walk_dir` -> `descend` -> `descend` shows no depth guard; an attacker-controlled directory tree can blow the stack.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit recursion-depth limit and surface a typed error when it is exceeded.

findings.title: Error swallowed two frames deep
findings.description: Walking `process_entry` -> `try_open` -> `_` discards the underlying `io::Error` and substitutes a generic message.
findings.recommendation: Propagate the source error via `#[source]` so callers can distinguish missing-file from permission-denied.
